notes.title: V2.1.13
notes.content:
Optimize backup system

1. Backup by copying the entire archive folder.

2. The save will be copied to the game directory Idle Exorcism Hero every half hour_ Data/StreamingAssets

3. The game can only be backed up after running for half an hour. There are a total of 3 backups.

4. If encountering archive damage, you can select a backup recovery option on the game's main interface.
